meta.title: Free ATS Resume & CV Builder, No Account or Sign-Up | Lanjut
meta.description: Build an ATS-friendly resume or CV for free. Open source, no account, no sign-up: your resume stays in your browser. Export PDF, Word, or plain text.
meta.features: ATS-friendly PDF, Word (DOCX), and plain-text export; six templates; import from PDF, JSON, or YAML; English and Indonesian; works in the browser with no account; profile backups that move to another device
meta.editorDescription: Start a resume from a blank page, the sample, your old resume, or a template. Free, no account, and saved in your browser.
meta.templateDescription: Six free resume templates that keep an order applicant tracking systems can read. See each one as a full page, on the sample or on your own resume.
meta.changelogDescription: What changed in each Lanjut release: the new features and fixes in the free, open-source ATS resume builder.

updater.title: Lanjut {version} is available
updater.description: You are up to date otherwise. Installing takes a moment and reopens the app.

welcome.title: Welcome to Lanjut
welcome.content: A free, local-first resume builder. Everything you write stays in this browser; nothing is ever sent to a server.

create.title: Create a resume
create.content: Start a new resume from here. You can keep as many as you like.

start.title: Pick how to start
start.content: Begin from a blank page, the sample, a resume you already have, or a template.

search.title: Find it later
search.content: Search your library by title once it grows.

nav.title: Get around
nav.content: Switch between your dashboard, the templates, and your profiles from here.

replay.title: Replay anytime
replay.content: Rerun the guide for whichever page you are on with this button.

navPhone.title: Get around
navPhone.content: Open this menu to switch between your dashboard, the templates, and your profiles.

replayPhone.title: Replay anytime
replayPhone.content: Press Guide in this menu to replay the tour for the page you are on.

browse.title: Browse templates
browse.content: Templates change presentation only: typography, spacing, accents. The structure stays linear so ATS parsers can always read your resume.

preview.title: Try it on
preview.content: Preview the template on the sample or on one of your resumes. Then start a new resume with it, or apply it to that one.

search.title: Search
search.content: Look up a template by name.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.content: This is your live preview, exactly what gets exported. It updates as you type and saves to this browser automatically.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.content: This bar shows how ready your resume is to send. Open it to see what is still missing, and pick an item to go straight to that field. Only your own words count, not the sample's.

sections.title: Content tab
sections.content: Fill in each section here. Drag to reorder them or hide the ones you don't need; the structure stays ATS-parseable underneath.

layout.title: Layout tab
layout.content: Swap templates from the Layout tab. Each one restyles typography and spacing only, so your content and its reading order never change.

styling.title: Styling tab
styling.content: Style the whole resume here, in three groups: Typography, Spacing, and General. Density sets the spacing in one click, and General switches the resume's language.

document.title: Document tab
document.content: Download your resume to send it, keep a JSON or YAML backup, or import a resume from a file or pasted text.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.content: This is your live preview, exactly what gets exported. It updates as you type and saves to this browser automatically.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.content: This bar shows how ready your resume is to send. Open it to see what is still missing, and pick an item to go straight to that field. Only your own words count, not the sample's.

edit.title: Open the editor
edit.content: Tap Edit anytime to open this panel and make changes.

sections.title: Content tab
sections.content: Fill in each section here. Drag to reorder them or hide the ones you don't need; the structure stays ATS-parseable underneath.

layout.title: Layout tab
layout.content: Swap templates from the Layout tab. Each one restyles typography and spacing only, so your content and its reading order never change.

styling.title: Styling tab
styling.content: Style the whole resume here, in three groups: Typography, Spacing, and General. Density sets the spacing in one click, and General switches the resume's language.

document.title: Document tab
document.content: Download your resume to send it, keep a JSON or YAML backup, or import a resume from a file or pasted text.

intro.title: Your profiles
intro.content: Keep one profile for each kind of job or job market. Each profile keeps its own resumes, and new resumes start with its information.

list.title: Pick one to edit
list.content: Open a profile to change its name, contact details, and summary. The active one is marked, and its resumes are the ones your library shows.

add.title: Add a profile
add.content: Make another profile when you apply for a different kind of job, or in another country.

import.title: Import a profile
import.content: Moving from another device? Import its backup file here. Lanjut shows what the file adds before anything changes, and never deletes anything.

backup.title: Back up a profile
backup.content: Download this profile and all its resumes as one file, or share it straight to your phone. Import the file on another device to carry on there.

backupNarrow.title: Back up a profile
backupNarrow.content: Open a profile and find Backup at the end of its details. It downloads the profile and all its resumes as one file, or shares it to another device.

switch.title: Switch from anywhere
switch.content: Your avatar in the top bar switches profiles from any page.

1_3_1.title: Bug fixes
1_3_1.description: Each answer on the home page now makes sense on its own, so search engines and AI tools quote it correctly. The Privacy page shows when it was last updated.

1_3_0.title: A privacy page
1_3_0.description: A new Privacy page, linked at the bottom of the home page, lists what stays on your device and every time Lanjut talks to a server.

1_3_0.title: Bug fixes
1_3_0.description: In Indonesian, the app now says CV everywhere instead of resume. The templates page has a short introduction, and several Indonesian sentences now read more naturally.

1_2_0.title: Templates in the menu
1_2_0.description: The menu at the top of the home page now has an "Explore templates" link, and its main button says "Build a resume". The editor and template pages also have shorter names in your browser tab.

1_1_0.title: An Indonesian sample résumé
1_1_0.description: In Indonesian, the sample résumé is now in Indonesian too, with Indonesian headings and dates. You see it on the home page, on the templates page, and when you start a new résumé from the sample.

1_1_0.title: Bug fixes
1_1_0.description: Screen readers and search engines now find one clear main heading on the home page, the templates page, and the feedback page. The home page answers "What is Lanjut?" first among its questions, and the Indonesian home page now says CV throughout. Importing a PDF of an Indonesian résumé now keeps its dates, a language list that starts with "Bahasa", and an address that wraps onto a second line.

1_0_0.title: Lanjut 1.0, now on Windows and Linux
1_0_0.description: The desktop app now runs on Windows and Linux, as well as on the Mac. It is the same editor, it keeps working offline, and your résumés stay on your own machine. Download it from the home page. The app is no longer a beta.

0_26_4.title: Bug fixes
0_26_4.description: On Windows, pages no longer show two gray scrollbars along their edges. On a wide screen, your library and the templates now use the full width of the window instead of a narrow column in the middle.

0_26_3.title: A faster home page
0_26_3.description: The home page now opens faster, most of all on phones. The sample resume shows right away, and the page stays smooth while Lanjut reads the PDF back. Downloading or importing a PDF no longer freezes the page either.

0_26_3.title: Bug fixes
0_26_3.description: The green buttons on the home page are a little darker, so their text is easier to read. Screen readers now read each template choice by the name you see.

0_26_2.title: Bug fixes
0_26_2.description: On a phone or a tablet, the template previews in the new resume steps now show each template as it really looks. The text was centered before.

0_26_1.title: Pages show at once
0_26_1.description: When you open your library, the templates, your profiles, or a resume in a browser, the page layout now shows right away and your content fills in a moment later. The loading animation that covered the whole page no longer shows there.

0_26_0.title: Developer mode: your resume as text
0_26_0.description: Turn on Developer mode in Preferences, and the editor gets a Form and Code switch. Code shows your resume as Markdown, YAML, or JSON, alone or beside the page, and the page follows the text as you type. Lanjut does not apply a text that has an error, so your resume stays as it was. Developer mode is off until you turn it on.

0_25_0.title: One tab edits at a time
0_25_0.description: Open the same resume or profile in two tabs, and only one tab edits it. The other shows that it is open elsewhere, and Edit here moves the editing to that tab. Your library and your profile list now update across tabs too.

0_24_1.title: Bug fixes
0_24_1.description: If the same resume or profile is open in two tabs, saving in one no longer overwrites changes made in the other. Lanjut asks which version to keep, and can save yours as a copy.

0_24_0.title: Works offline
0_24_0.description: After your first visit to the app, Lanjut opens, saves, and exports with no internet. A PDF in a template you have not used yet needs the internet once, to get its fonts.

0_23_1.title: Bug fixes
0_23_1.description: If an older copy of Lanjut is still open in another tab, it no longer saves over a resume that a newer copy changed. It tells you so and asks you to refresh the page.

0_23_0.title: Paste or drop your photo
0_23_0.description: The photo field in Personal Information now takes an image you paste or drop. Copy a photo, open Personal Information, and press Ctrl+V or Cmd+V. Or drag the image file onto the photo field.

0_22_0.title: Lead with your skills
0_22_0.description: The section order menu, beside undo and redo above the preview, now offers Skills first. It moves Skills right below your summary, for a resume that leads with what you can do. Experience first brings back the standard order. Your entries still list the newest first.

0_21_3.title: Bug fixes
0_21_3.description: Importing a PDF that Lanjut made now brings back the company context line, company and project links, and each certificate’s issuer, and reads the Ketat and Luasa layouts correctly. Text the PDF prints in capitals still comes back in capitals.

0_21_2.title: Bug fixes
0_21_2.description: Russian and other Cyrillic text now prints in your PDF with every template and font. With the default fonts it used to come out blank. Letters such as ł, ő, and ş from other European languages print now too.

0_21_1.title: Bug fixes
0_21_1.description: The changelog was missing the 0.21.0 release. It is there now.

0_21_0.title: Every release in one place
0_21_0.description: The changelog now has its own page, Changelog, under Other in the sidebar. It lists every Lanjut release, newest first, with its date and what changed, and each version links to its release on GitHub. The footer of the home page links to it too.

0_20_3.title: Bug fixes
0_20_3.description: On phones and tablets, a template preview now opens in a panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen, and the whole page fits its width.

0_20_2.title: Bug fixes
0_20_2.description: On phones, the icon and the label on each tile under Create a new resume now line up.

0_20_1.title: Bug fixes
0_20_1.description: Fixed two bugs on phones. On an iPhone, the sheet in the home page demo now moves when you drag it. The home page also no longer scrolls sideways.

0_20_0.title: A clearer link preview
0_20_0.description: When you share a link to Lanjut in a chat or a post, its preview image now says what Lanjut is: a free, open-source resume builder that needs no account and keeps your resume on your device. A resume page sits beside the text. A link to the Indonesian site gets its own image, written in Indonesian.

0_19_1.title: Bug fixes
0_19_1.description: The people who build Lanjut now appear on the home page as soon as it opens. Before, their faces stayed grey circles until you scrolled down to them.

0_19_0.title: See your resume before you create it
0_19_0.description: Creating a resume now takes three short steps: where to start, which template, and a name. On a large screen, a preview beside the steps shows every page as you choose, even for a file you import. On a phone, swipe through the templates.

0_19_0.title: Profiles for every kind of job
0_19_0.description: Keep one profile for each kind of job or job market. Each profile keeps its own resumes, and every new resume in it starts with its name, contact details, and summary. Manage profiles on the new Profiles page, and switch between them from your avatar in the top bar. A short tour shows you around the first time you open it. Theme, language, and animation now live in Preferences in the same menu.

0_19_0.title: A library that starts where you stopped
0_19_0.description: Your library now opens on the resume you edited last, one click from the editor. Below it, start a new resume from a blank page, the sample, a file, or a template. Every resume shows its template, and you can sort by name or last edit and switch between a grid and a list.

0_19_0.title: Try a template on your own resume
0_19_0.description: The template page now shows each template at full size, every page. Preview it on the sample or on one of your resumes, then apply it in one click. If you change your mind, Undo in the editor brings the old template back.

0_19_0.title: A sidebar that folds to icons
0_19_0.description: Hide the sidebar and it now folds into a slim row of icons instead of leaving the screen. Hover an icon to see its name. Open, it lists your five latest resumes.

0_19_0.title: Meet the people behind Lanjut
0_19_0.description: Your library now thanks everyone who builds Lanjut, with a direct way to join them: translate it, fix a bug, or build a feature.

0_19_0.title: Feedback that gets fixed faster
0_19_0.description: Send feedback now walks you through what helps most: what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. It shows reports like yours as you type, tells you exactly what it attaches, and links you to the issue once it is filed. You can also point out a wrong word or translation.

0_19_0.title: Your PDF now matches the preview
0_19_0.description: PDF downloads are now drawn from the same page you see in the editor, so the fonts, sizes, and spacing in the file match the preview. The text stays selectable for applicant tracking systems.

0_19_0.title: Turn animations off
0_19_0.description: A new settings menu in the top bar holds your language and an animation switch. Pick Off to stop movement on screen, or System to follow your device. The theme switch now sits right next to it.

0_19_0.title: Know your résumé is saved
0_19_0.description: The top bar of the editor now shows when your résumé is saved on this device. If the browser ever refuses to save, it tells you right away and how to keep a copy.

0_19_0.title: See how ready your resume is
0_19_0.description: A bar above your resume preview shows how ready it is to send, from 0% to Ready to send. Open it to see what is still missing, and pick an item to go straight to that field. Only your own words count, not the sample's. The library's first card shows the same score as a ring.

0_19_0.title: More room for the preview on large screens
0_19_0.description: On a wide screen, the editing panel keeps a comfortable width, and the page preview gets the extra room.

0_19_0.title: A faster first PDF
0_19_0.description: Your first PDF download now starts sooner. The editor gets the PDF maker ready while you open the download, and it loads only the fonts your template uses.

0_19_0.title: A Styling tab
0_19_0.description: Font, sizes, spacing, and the resume's language now have their own Styling tab, grouped into Typography, Spacing, and General. Each slider shows its value, each group has its own reset, and a Density choice (Compact, Balanced, Airy) sets the spacing in one click.

0_19_0.title: A clearer Document tab
0_19_0.description: The Document tab is now grouped into Download, Backup, and Import. Each download format says when to use it, and a JSON or YAML backup can be copied or downloaded in one place.

0_19_0.title: Forms that use a wider panel
0_19_0.description: Drag the editing panel wider, and the fields in each section sit side by side in two columns.

0_19_0.title: Paste JSON or YAML
0_19_0.description: Paste a resume you copied as JSON or YAML into the Document tab. The text shows in color, and any mistake shows before you import it.

0_19_0.title: Back up a profile
0_19_0.description: Download a profile with all its resumes as one small file, then import it on another device to carry on there. On a phone, Share sends it through AirDrop, Nearby Share, or a cloud app. Nothing goes to a server, and an import never deletes anything: where both devices have a resume, the newer one wins.

0_19_0.title: Bug fixes
0_19_0.description: During a guided tour, the button that a step points at no longer reacts to a click or a key, so the tour cannot open a menu or a sheet under its own card. Importing a PDF résumé now puts each link in its own field, such as your website or a certificate link, instead of showing the address as text.

0_18_0.title: Add context about a company
0_18_0.description: Experience and internship entries now have an optional company context field for briefly explaining an unfamiliar employer. It appears in every preview and export before your achievements.

0_17_2.title: Bug fixes
0_17_2.description: On phones, the resume demo on the home page ran far past the edge of the screen and made the whole page too wide. It now fits.

0_17_1.title: The Mac app can update itself
0_17_1.description: When a new version is out, the Mac app now offers it to you. It looks at most once every few days, and nothing installs until you click.

0_17_1.title: Bug fixes
0_17_1.description: In the Mac app the sidebar covered the page when the app opened, and the button that hides it did nothing. Both are fixed.

0_17_0.title: The Mac app checks for updates
0_17_0.description: The Mac app now looks for new versions. This release went out without the files an update needs, so updates only began to work in 0.17.1.

0_16_2.title: Bug fixes
0_16_2.description: In the Mac app, the sidebar opened on top of the page, and its collapse button did nothing until you switched languages. The window now lays out correctly when it opens.

0_16_1.title: Bug fixes
0_16_1.description: The 0.16.0 release went out with no Mac app attached, so the download button on the home page led to an empty release. The app is there now.

0_16_0.title: Lanjut on your Mac
0_16_0.description: There is now a Mac app. It is the same builder you already use, running on your own machine, and it keeps working with the network off. Your resumes stay on that machine. Download it from the link on the home page. It is a beta and it is not signed by Apple yet, so macOS will ask you to confirm the first time you open it.

0_16_0.title: A page for feedback
0_16_0.description: Bug reports and feature requests now have their own page, so you can send one from anywhere, including from the Mac app. You still do not need a GitHub account.

0_15_0.title: Getting the Mac app ready
0_15_0.description: This release built most of the Mac app. The Lanjut logo shows while it starts, you can send feedback from inside it, links open in your browser, and an export asks where to save the file. The download link came in the next release.

0_14_0.title: Add a photo to your header
0_14_0.description: You can now put a photo on your resume. It is optional and off by default. Add it in Personal Information, then pick the size, corner roundness, and position. It comes along in PDF and Word exports, and the text of your resume stays fully readable to parsers.

0_14_0.title: A fresh new look
0_14_0.description: Lanjut has a new logo and a rebuilt landing page. The previews there are rendered by the real templates, so what you see is exactly what you get.

0_14_0.title: Support Lanjut
0_14_0.description: Lanjut is free and always will be. If it helped you, you can now support development through Saweria or SociaBuzz, right from the sidebar or the footer.

0_13_0.title: One more link in your header
0_13_0.description: A new optional Link field sits next to LinkedIn in Personal Information, for your portfolio, GitHub, or anything else. It shows in the preview and every export, and importing a PDF picks it up too.

0_12_0.title: Undo and redo
0_12_0.description: Change your mind freely: every edit can now be undone and redone, from typing and deleted entries to section order and layout settings. Use the arrows beside the sidebar tabs or Ctrl/Cmd+Z, and each text field keeps its own history while you write.

0_12_0.title: One section at a time
0_12_0.description: The editor list now keeps a single section open, so the form you are working in stays in view instead of pushing the others off screen.

0_12_0.title: Bug fixes
0_12_0.description: Fixed three reported bugs: links in your exports now show as clickable, a stray dash no longer appears in the PDF contact line, and locations land in the right field when you import a PDF.

0_11_0.title: Company location
0_11_0.description: Experience and internship entries now carry a location, shown next to the employer in the preview, the PDF, and every other export. Education locations render too, instead of being kept out of sight.

0_10_2.title: Bug fixes
0_10_2.description: An entry in your PDF no longer splits across two pages. When an entry does not fit at the bottom of a page, the whole entry moves to the next one, as it does in the preview.

0_10_1.title: Bug fixes
0_10_1.description: Fixed two bugs. Words with fi or fl in your PDF now come through whole when a tool pulls out the text. "fintech" used to come back as "fntech", and some applicant tracking systems read PDFs this way. In the Projects section, the project name is now the link, not your role.

0_10_0.title: Feedback without a GitHub account
0_10_0.description: Report a bug or request a feature right from the app; we file the GitHub issue for you under the name you provide, guarded by a quick verification.

0_10_0.title: JSON and YAML export and import
0_10_0.description: Copy or download your resume as JSON or YAML, and import either back losslessly. Rich text travels as simple markdown.

0_10_0.title: Hide sections
0_10_0.description: Every section, Summary included, now has an eye toggle in the editor list. Hidden sections keep their content but drop out of the preview and every export until you show them again.

0_10_0.title: Hide contact icons
0_10_0.description: A new toggle in the Document tab hides the small icons next to your contact details, for a plainer header in the preview and PDF. Your contact text always stays.

0_10_0.title: Section spacing
0_10_0.description: A slider in the Document tab adjusts the room above every section, in the preview and the PDF alike. Open it up for an airy layout, or tighten it below each template's default until sections sit flush.

0_10_0.title: Choose your font
0_10_0.description: Pick from fifteen resume-safe fonts, grouped as sans, serif, and mono, and the whole document follows in the preview and the PDF. Every template keeps its own default until you choose, and the preview now renders the exact same font files the PDF embeds.

0_10_0.title: Line height and letter spacing
0_10_0.description: Two more sliders in the Document tab, resting at each template's real values: tighten or loosen line height and letter spacing either way, both bounded to the range where PDF text still extracts cleanly, so your styling never costs you ATS parsing.

0_10_0.title: Font size controls
0_10_0.description: Resize your name, section headings, and body text independently from the Document tab. Each slider scales its group on top of the template's proportions, so a bigger name never flattens the rest, and the preview and PDF stay in step.

0_9_3.title: Bug fixes
0_9_3.description: A deleted resume could come back after you reloaded the page. Deleting now removes it from your device at once, and Undo still brings it back while the countdown runs. The guided tour's backdrop also stands out in the dark theme now.

0_9_2.title: Bug fixes
0_9_2.description: The home page loads faster on phones, because its screenshots now download at the size your screen shows them. The language switch also works better with screen readers.

0_9_1.title: Bug fixes
0_9_1.description: A problem kept new versions of Lanjut from going live: the PDF and Word export code made the site too big to publish. It is fixed, and updates go out again.

0_9_0.title: Import from PDF
0_9_0.description: Start a new resume from an existing PDF. Lanjut reads it in your browser and fills the sections for you to tidy up.

0_9_0.title: Custom sections
0_9_0.description: Add your own sections beyond the built-in set, either as a rich text block or a list of entries.

0_9_0.title: Reorder certifications
0_9_0.description: Drag certifications into the order you want, the same way skills and languages already work.

0_9_0.title: Hide proficiency
0_9_0.description: Turn the proficiency level off on skills and languages when you would rather just list them, with a toggle in each section.

0_9_0.title: Language columns
0_9_0.description: Show your languages in one column or two, matching the layout control already in Skills.

0_9_0.title: Undo a deletion
0_9_0.description: Deleting a resume now waits ten seconds and shows an Undo, so an accidental delete is easy to take back.

0_9_0.title: Duplicate a resume
0_9_0.description: Copy any resume from its menu to branch a new version without starting over.

0_8_0.title: Skills column layout
0_8_0.description: A toggle in the Skills section switches between one and two columns, and your choice carries through to the preview and every export.

0_8_0.title: Newest entries first
0_8_0.description: The editor lists your entries newest first, matching the order they appear in the preview, so the forms and your resume always line up.

0_8_0.title: New landing navbar
0_8_0.description: The landing page has a new navigation bar, with a menu that opens cleanly on mobile.

0_8_0.title: Page load progress
0_8_0.description: Moving between pages shows a slim progress bar at the top, so you get instant feedback while a page loads.

0_7_0.title: Internship section
0_7_0.description: List internships as their own entries, separate from full-time roles, with the same fields as Experience.

0_7_0.title: Projects section
0_7_0.description: Give side projects, open-source work, and anything you have shipped their own space, each with a name, link, dates, and description.

0_7_0.title: Blank resume preview
0_7_0.description: A blank resume shows a preview placeholder in your library instead of an empty white card, so a new resume looks intentional until you start writing.

0_6_0.title: Bahasa Indonesia
0_6_0.description: Switch the entire interface between English and Indonesian anytime with the language toggle in the navbar.

0_6_0.title: Per-resume language
0_6_0.description: Pick English or Indonesian per document, and the section headings and dates in your PDF, DOCX, and TXT exports follow that choice.

0_6_0.title: Reorder skills and languages
0_6_0.description: Grab the handle next to an entry and drag it into place, or use the keyboard to move it. The new order flows straight into the preview and every export.

0_6_0.title: Empty section prompts
0_6_0.description: Instead of a lone button, each section without entries shows a short prompt for what to add.

0_6_0.title: Refreshed hero gradient
0_6_0.description: The landing page hero heading has a new gradient, tuned for both light and dark mode.

0_5_0.title: Switch templates in the editor
0_5_0.description: The new Layout tab shows your resume rendered in every template, and one click applies your pick.

0_5_0.title: Start from a blank resume
0_5_0.description: Untick “Pre-fill with example content” in the create dialog to begin with a blank document instead of the example resume.

0_5_0.title: Emptyable sections
0_5_0.description: Every entry has a delete button, and removing the last one drops the section from the preview until you add another.

0_4_1.title: Bug fixes
0_4_1.description: On small screens, the buttons in the top bar sit in a row again, and the close button on side panels is rounded like the other controls.

0_4_0.title: Organization section
0_4_0.description: Showcase volunteer, student, and community roles with dates and highlights, just like work experience. It shows up in every template and export, and existing resumes get it automatically.

0_4_0.title: Safer app updates
0_4_0.description: A backup copy is kept on your device before any data-format upgrade, and a resume the app cannot read yet is flagged with a notice instead of disappearing.

0_4_0.title: Guided tour
0_4_0.description: A guided tour walks you through the dashboard, the templates, and the editor on your first visit.

0_4_0.title: Landing page walkthrough
0_4_0.description: The landing page walks through how Lanjut works, ending with a one-click way to start a new resume.

0_4_0.title: Report bugs and requests

descriptions.awal: A clean, single-column ATS-safe starter. Linear reading order, no columns or tables, with room for every section.
descriptions.ketat: A compact serif classic: centered ruled section headings, right-aligned contact column, and italic dates. Dense without feeling cramped.
descriptions.luasa: An airy minimalist layout: letterspaced headings, a single contact line, and slim accent bars. Generous whitespace throughout.
descriptions.tebal: A bold, modern statement: oversized name, heavy uppercase headings over thick rules, and strong typographic hierarchy.
descriptions.klasik: A traditional all-serif CV: centered name and contacts, quiet centered headings, and italic dates. Timeless and formal.
descriptions.ketik: A typewriter-flavored technical look: monospace name, headings, and dates over a clean sans body. Built for developers.

landing.srHeading: Lanjut, a free ATS resume and CV builder:
landing.deck: First an ATS parser pulls out the text, then a recruiter looks at the page. Lanjut makes one résumé, or CV, that works for both. It is free, needs no account, and never leaves your browser.

landing.looksBody: Six templates, each with its own type and spacing. Pick one and the résumé above is read again. The sections come back in the same order, and every change to Lanjut is tested for it.
landing.localHeading: Your résumé never leaves this browser.
landing.localBody: There is no account and no copy on a server. Lanjut keeps your résumés in your browser's own storage, and you can export them as PDF, DOCX, plain text, JSON, or YAML whenever you want.
landing.localSource: Lanjut is open source under AGPL-3.0.

landing.closeHeading: Free, no account, and open source.
landing.closeBody: There is no paid plan and no account to make. The code is public under AGPL-3.0, and anyone can read it or run their own copy.
landing.contributorsBody: Made by people who give their time to it. Join them: add a translation, fix a bug, or build the feature you wish it had.

footer.tagline: A free ATS résumé and CV builder that keeps your work in your browser.

landing.keptHeading: Some things stay out on purpose.
landing.keptBody: Parsers read a page from top to bottom. Anything that breaks that order can scramble your text, so Lanjut keeps it out of the content and leaves everything else up to you.
landing.outTablesWhy: Cells can be read in an order you never meant.
landing.outColumnsWhy: Side-by-side lines can merge into one jumbled line.
landing.outBoxesWhy: Text outside the main flow is easy to skip.
landing.outImagesWhy: A parser reads text, not images.
landing.keptPhoto: The header photo is the one exception. It is optional, off by default, and never changes the text a parser reads.
landing.importHeading: Already have a résumé? Start from it.
landing.importBody: Drop in a PDF, or a JSON or YAML file you exported earlier. Lanjut sorts what it finds into sections, and anything it can't place waits in a list you can copy from. The file is read in your browser, like everything else.
landing.exportsBody: Each application asks for something different. All five come from the same résumé, so they never drift apart.

whatIs.question: What is Lanjut?
whatIs.answer: Lanjut is a free, open-source résumé and CV builder made for applicant tracking systems (ATS). It runs in your browser at lanjut.org, and as a desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. There is no account, and your résumés stay on your device. Six templates change the look but never the reading order, so a parser reads every template the same way. You can export a PDF, a Word file (.docx), or plain text. Rizki Citra builds it in the open on GitHub, with contributors.

free.question: Is Lanjut really free?
free.answer: Yes, Lanjut is free. There is no paid plan and no account. If you want to support the work, you can donate through Saweria or SociaBuzz. Both links are in the footer.

account.question: Do I need to sign up or make an account?
account.answer: No, Lanjut needs no account. Open the editor and start writing. There is no sign-up, no login, and no email to give, because your résumés stay in this browser instead of on a server.

openSource.question: Is Lanjut open source?
openSource.answer: Yes, Lanjut is open source. The code is on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 license. You can read how it works, report a bug, or contribute a fix or a translation.

storage.question: Where is my résumé saved?
storage.answer: Your résumé is saved in this browser, on this device. Lanjut keeps your résumés in the browser's own storage and sends nothing to a server. If you clear your site data or switch browsers, the résumés stay behind, so back up your profile on the Profiles page. One file holds the profile and all its résumés, and it imports on another device.

files.question: Which file should I send?
files.answer: Send the PDF to most upload forms and by email. Send the .docx when a portal or a recruiter asks for Word. Paste the .txt into forms that only take plain text.

ats.question: Will my résumé get through an applicant tracking system?
ats.answer: No tool can promise that, because each company sets up its system its own way. Lanjut takes care of the part the file controls: real text in reading order, standard section headings, and contact details a parser can find. The sheet at the top of this page shows the text a parser reads back from your PDF.

cv.question: Is Lanjut a CV builder too?
cv.answer: Yes, Lanjut is a CV builder too. Many countries call a résumé a CV, and Lanjut builds the same document under either name: your experience, education, and skills, in an order an applicant tracking system can read.

import.question: Can I import the résumé I already have?
import.answer: Yes, you can import your résumé. Drop in a PDF, or a JSON or YAML file you exported from Lanjut. The PDF needs real text, so a scanned page or a password-protected file cannot be read. Any line Lanjut cannot place goes to a list you can copy from.

language.question: Can I write my résumé in Indonesian?
language.answer: Yes, you can write your résumé in Indonesian. Set the document language to Indonesian in the editor, and the fixed labels, such as section headings and dates, change with it. The app itself is in English and Indonesian too.

photo.question: Can I add a photo?
photo.answer: Yes, you can add a photo. The header photo is optional and off by default. It shows in the PDF and the .docx, the .txt leaves it out, and it never changes the text a parser reads.

privacy.metaDescription: What Lanjut keeps and what it sends. Your résumés stay in your browser, nothing is uploaded, and there is no account, no analytics, and no ads.
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.lead: You need no account to use Lanjut, and it has no analytics or ads. Your résumés stay on your device. Below is every time the site talks to a server, so you can check each one.
privacy.storedBody: Your résumés, your profiles, and your settings are saved in your browser's own storage on this device. They are never sent to a server. If you clear the site's data or change browsers, they are gone, so keep a backup from the Profile page.
privacy.networkTitle: When Lanjut talks to a server

hosting.title: Loading the site.
hosting.body: Cloudflare serves lanjut.org. Like any web host, it receives the usual details of each request, such as your IP address and browser.

language.title: Your language.
language.body: When you pick a language, a small cookie remembers it, so lanjut.org opens in that language next time.

offline.title: Offline use.
offline.body: The site keeps a copy of its own files in your browser, so it still opens without a connection. That copy holds no résumé.

feedback.title: Feedback.
feedback.body: When you send feedback, what you write becomes a public issue on GitHub. Before you send it, you see the technical details that go with it, such as your browser and the page, and you can leave them out. Your résumé text is never part of it. A Cloudflare check (Turnstile) confirms that a person sent it.

contributors.title: Contributors.
contributors.body: The home page shows the people who build Lanjut. Your browser loads their profile pictures from GitHub.

updates.title: Desktop updates.
updates.body: The desktop app checks GitHub for a new version at most once every three days. Nothing installs until you click.

donations.title: Donations.
donations.body: The Saweria and SociaBuzz links are plain links. Those sites open only when you click them.

privacy.codeBody: Lanjut is open source under AGPL-3.0. The code that does everything on this page is public on GitHub.
